scenario_name: 1 omitted dimensions; intended use: Play space / Baby parking (Centro di custodia oraria)
initial_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. I intend to assess a conversion into a play space / baby parking (hourly childcare), subject to confirmation of the applicable authorization regime. The location is in Turin. I need a property with at least 115 sqm of gross floor area and capacity for 15 people. I prefer a property in energy class D or better.
submitted_query: I am looking for an existing commercial unit. final_sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Commercial activities and similar' AND surface_area >= 115 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
